title: Worker entitlement clause (rules-as-data)
description: A cited clause describing what a displaced worker may be entitled to. Aadesh NEVER asserts that a payment will be made, and never invents an amount.

quote.description: VERBATIM text from the cited page.

amount.description: OPTIONAL and CITATION-BACKED. Null unless a specific figure is stated in a hashed source document. When null, Aadesh reports displaced worker-days instead of rupees, which is always provable. Never populate this from a news article or from memory.

basis.description: What the figure is denominated in. Required so the UI never multiplies a one-time figure by days.

quote.description: The VERBATIM sentence stating this figure. The amount carries its own citation, independent of the clause's.

readiness_requirements.description: What a worker still needs in order to claim. May be empty while unsourced. Each item carries its own citation.
